access_policy: Same original URL, host and default route; no access-control workaround.
failure_gate: Stop after first error; save error/result/log and actual process exit; no automatic retry.
forbidden_actions: make further requests without another frozen prospective plan
request_policy: One separately authorized retry of original zero-byte failure; no replay of cached ranges.
science_rules: Original AZ prepower selection, normalization, thresholds, drift range and all gates remain unchanged.
scientific_scope: Recovery metadata only. No new detector search, candidate assessment or credited coverage.
source_identity_limit: ETag and exact range checks do not verify full original-file MD5 or astronomical origin.
success_gate: Exact206, original URL, matching ETag, Content-Range and 16384 bytes; save receipt and bytes separately.
timing_limit: The original local freeze preceded the request. GitHub publication follows execution; no public preregistration timestamp is claimed.
